original_question: Which autosomal semi-dominant form of the genetic skin disorder caused by the Filaggrin gene is responsible for over 95% of all cases?

final_qi.question: Which autosomal semi-dominant form of the genetic skin disorder caused by the Filaggrin gene is responsible for over 95% of all cases?
final_qi.search_keyword: autosomal semi-dominant genetic skin disorder Filaggrin gene 95% cases
final_qi.long_answer: Ichthyosis vulgaris is an autosomal semi-dominant form of ichthyosis caused by heterozygous loss-of-function mutations in the filaggrin (FLG) gene. It is the most common form of the genetic skin disorder, responsible for over 95% of cases, and exhibits variable expressivity despite its high penetrance.
